# Model Check

A **track** is one sequential line of work; steps in the same track never overlap, and anything that happens while something else is happening belongs in a different track. A **step** has exactly one duration kind: `fixed` (a single `seconds` value), `variable` (with `minSeconds`, `maxSeconds`, and optionally `defaultSeconds` for planning), or `indefinite` (runs until the person manually ends it). A **startTrigger** ties a step to the clock or to another step using one of several types: `programStart` (at t=0), `programStartOffset` (at a delayed time), `afterStep` (when another step ends or starts), `afterStepWithBuffer` (when another step ends plus a delay), `manual` (user tap), `onAbort` (only if another step is aborted), or `compound` (multiple conditions). **stepId**s are unique across the WHOLE program, not scoped per track, so no two steps anywhere can share the same ID. Every `task` that a step occupies needs a matching `resourceConstraints` entry, and that entry's `maxConcurrent` defines how many steps can claim that task at the same instant — for example, `maxConcurrent: 1` means only one step uses the oven at a time. Work repeated n times (n trays, n samples, n cultures) is declared once with `replicates: {count: n, mode: "serial" | "parallel" | "stagger"}` on a single step — never copied n times — and steps that follow each instance chain with `{"type":"afterStep","stepId":"<step>","instances":"each"}`, while steps that wait for all instances use `{"instances":"all"}`; when a holding area (rack, rotor, incubator shelf, taxiway) only fits k items at once, set `replicates.maxInFlight: k` to prevent the upstream step from creating a bottleneck jam.

```json
{
  "acknowledgement": "tracks are sequential lines of work; one duration kind per step; triggers link steps; every task needs a resourceConstraint; stepIds are global",
  "resourceConstraints": [
    { "task": "burner_loop", "maxConcurrent": 1, "reason": "one loop station at the burner" },
    { "task": "incubator_shelf", "maxConcurrent": 2, "reason": "37 °C incubator shelf holding two plates max" },
    { "task": "staining_rack", "maxConcurrent": 1, "reason": "one staining rack" },
    { "task": "microscope", "maxConcurrent": 1, "reason": "one microscope" },
    { "task": "bench", "maxConcurrent": 1, "reason": "one technician working the bench (general prep, holding)" }
  ],
  "actors": 2,
  "reason": "one technician working the bench, one supervisor signing off readings"
}
```
